exposure: Familial 1.3-Mb duplication in chromosomal region 11p15.5p15.4 involving both imprinting control regions (ICRs)
cohort: A family across three generations with a pure 1.3-Mb duplication in chromosomal region 11p15.5p15.4.
finding: A familial 1.3-Mb duplication in chromosomal region 11p15.5p15.4 involving both ICRs can cause either an SRS or BWS phenotype depending on parental inheritance.
